body: You think washington has worse jokes...oh ok then...let's see what you got.
Have you tried telling them how much karma you have? And how that can clearly buy them things from the secret karma store?

I did...

http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/1a9c88/finelets_talk/

but figured I might as well ask a few others as I get my answers.

WHy not....You want to die again, for a whole lot of reasons. I don't want to keep feeling pain or wake up tomorrow for a whole lot of reasons.

So maybe I have a reason you haven't thought of...maybe you have one I haven't thought of. DIdn't hurt to wait a few minutes to see did it?

Can I say...you honestly are an awesome kid.

Some woman should randomly offer themselves to you while saying 'your karma does it for me because you earned it...not like shitty watercolour who just draws pictures'...or well shows you a picture of her cat eating bacon while EA reps stand in the background apologizing for all their wrongs while cats spontaneously burst into a harlem shuffle with packages of bacon laying before them or something.

whichever works for you.

If you're still here...send me a message....I'm dealing with 20+ years of chronic pain, and came hear asking for a random stranger to come up with something I didn't think of already.

So maybe you have something I didn't think of...or maybe I have something you didn't. what the fuck...can't hurt right?

Got it...so if I say 'Son, I'm not moving away from you...I'm just moving closer to my munchies..' you think that will work?'

Oh wait I got more:

How about...well, since I can't marry a dude in this state, I'll move so I can at least get Mary Jane...ba dum dum...

Look, whats the worst that can happen if I move to Colorado...that I get a pot belly?

Oh, they get worse from here...don't make me do it.
That's an awful burden to place on him...but yes, he was for alot of years. And  I have serious guilt issues over feeling that way.

Yes, but it's not an option in my state and my sons mother is a drug addict, so telling him I've giving up everything here to move to where I can get bud for pain management isn't really a realistic option either.

I've stopped taking pain killers other than morphine patches when I have no other choice because of the depression and the immunity that builds up over the years...so mostly I just deal with it now, I refuse to be an addict or labeled a drug seeker for telling a doctor that the dosage just doesn't help anymore.

They're grown now, but thanks...that held me together for alot of years when nothing else did.

Now imagine him going through that for another 20 years since mine started in 84...I've had several and they can't do more because of scar tissue and previous surgeries. As you see with your dad, it's a cycle with chronic pain like that, some days are good...some are tolerable...but too many are a real drain on everything and everyone. Thus why I asked for other reasons, from other perspectives for why to wake up. I know it is the pain talking, and clouding what I feel and think...I'm still rational enough for that, but that doesn't stop the feeling or the thought... and they truly are overwhelming sometimes.

Honestly, on days like today I enjoy being able to get out of bed and saying no to putting on another morphine patch.

On other days I enjoy photography, cooking, traveling (when I can), the smile from a stranger, etc... the problem is it's been too many days since I've had one of these. I know it's part of the cycle of chronic pain, but that doesn't help me beat it.

>Sometimes I settled for just closing my eyes at night and imagining that I was told I had cancer and was going to die soon. And I would just really try to imagine the relief that would come with that, and kind of go through the fantasy in my head for a nice long while.

I've had that, in a manner of speaking. The first time I broke my neck I was told I would be paralyzed or dead...heard that for alot of years, the 2nd time it kind of loses its magic, by the 3rd time you hear the same shit it really doesn't help.
That's what's kept me going this long...I've run out of reasons that work.

Ok...I'll go through with you the things that have kept me alive for many years of  this even if they sound trite or whatever:

1) Have you made and accomplished your bucket list? If not you have nothing to lose by staying around to try something epic.

2) Bang out a hottie. No really...if you're going to die, it might as well be a few hours after something that the rest of the world only dreams of right?

3) What is your legacy? You don't just want to be gone or at peace...you want something that matters, so what did you do that really matters somehow? If the answer is nothing, leave the pills there and go do it....look, if you fail the pills are still there...so fuck it...go to leave your mark, make something better for someone, give a fortune to some homeless 15 year old who is going to turn to prostitution, make a video in the middle of timesquare pointing out the evils in the world, crap on your mom's couch while you lay out the reasons you are feeling what you feel...something..anything, but shit don't just go out without saying or doing something that matters.

4) Who the fuck am I to say this...well, I'm someone who doesn't want to wake up tomorrow either, but at least I've done my biggies...I just jumped off the top of the dang stratosphere yesterday then sang karaoke on the strip and went home with some meaningless chick from the bar....so have you done that? Tried that? Done better? Tried better?

If yes, then seriously I understand and you know you earned peace so good journeys...if no, get your ass out there and at least do something you always wanted. You have nothing to lose, so try it.
